subject: Next steps: supplier onboarding & payment path for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@hydratech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: supplier onboarding & payment path for Redwood pilot

Hi Emma — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your AP/procurement team can map us into HydraTech's process:

- Scope: 6-week pilot (hosted inference) for two product teams; estimated first-month spend ~$9k, steady-state TBD.
- Commercial path we discussed: pilot on card (fast), production via PO + vendor onboarding (preferred if > $10k).
- AP asks: vendor portal invite, W9, SOC 2 Type II, standard vendor packet.

Attachments: Redwood_Intro_SOW.pdf (summary SOW), Redwood_Vendor_Packet.zip (W9, SOC2 cert, vendor form templates).

Proposed next steps:
1) If procurement prefers PO route, can you share the supplier portal invite link or point person?
2) If card is acceptable for pilot, I can provision a card invoice and get us started same-day.
3) We can also list Redwood on AWS Marketplace if you'd prefer procurement to buy via marketplace — let me know if I should include marketplace pricing/options in the quote.
4) I’ll follow up with a formal quote (line-item format) and a short checklist for your supplier portal.

If useful, Ben (cc) can join a brief call with your AP team to walk through documents and timelines. What’s your preference?

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@hydratech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@hydratech.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: supplier onboarding & payment path for Redwood pilot

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from procurement side:

- HydraTech policy: vendors with expected spend > $10k must be onboarded and paid via PO. Pilots under $10k can be paid by card if vendor supports invoice-to-card.
- Supplier portal: please register here — we can push an invite once you register: https://supplier.hydratech.com/onboard. Our portal requires a completed vendor questionnaire and W9 (US vendors). SOC 2 Type II is strongly preferred for SaaS vendors.
- Timeline: onboarding + vendor verification typically 7–15 business days once all docs are submitted; expedited on request (2–3 business days) if security docs and W9 are pre-provided.

Requests for your quote: please provide line-item pricing for pilot (hosting, support, estimated tokens), and a separate production estimate that shows unit economics for batch/steady-state. Also indicate whether Redwood can accept PO + Net30 terms after credit review (we prefer Net30).

We are also exploring marketplace purchases for smaller teams; please include a note if AWS Marketplace is an option and any pricing differences.

Thanks — I’ll loop in AP if we move forward with PO.

Best,
Emma Liu
Head of Procurement
HydraTech Logistics
emma.liu@hydratech.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@hydratech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: supplier onboarding & payment path for Redwood pilot

Emma — perfect, thanks. I attached an initial line-item quote (Redwood_Quote_v1.pdf) and added a short note on marketplace options. Highlights:

- Pilot option: card-friendly invoice for <$10k pilots (we can accept card payments via Stripe).
- PO/Net30: we support PO invoicing with Net30 after a standard credit and entity verification; SOC 2 + W9 speeds up approval.
- Marketplace: Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace (Marketplace procurement results in standard AWS billing; pricing is consistent but invoicing/terms differ — we’ll include a marketplace SKU in the revised quote if you want it).

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll register in your supplier portal and request an invite (unless you prefer to send the invite link directly).
- Ben (cc) will be the onboarding lead and can submit the completed vendor questionnaire and SOC 2 docs via the portal.
- If you confirm PO route, please share the PO template or preferred PO fields so our finance team can mirror them in the invoice.

If acceptable I’ll plan to submit paperwork tomorrow; happy to stand up a 20-min call with AP to accelerate.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@hydratech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@hydratech.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: supplier onboarding & payment path for Redwood pilot

Naomi — quick update from AP after reviewing your packet: they are happy to proceed via a PO for the pilot (we’ll keep it as a one-time PO to start). Action items for Redwood:

1) Please submit the vendor registration at https://supplier.hydratech.com/onboard and send me the registration confirmation so we can push the invite.
2) Upload W9 and SOC 2 Type II (or a SOC 2 letter of attestation) to the portal.
3) Send an invoice-ready quote with PO line items (unit descriptions, qty, unit price, total, tax status) and a billing address for Redwood.

AP expects to issue a PO within ~5 business days after the vendor record is complete. If you want us to expedite, we can try the 2–3 business day path but will need SOC 2 + W9 up front.

We are not using AWS Marketplace for this initial engagement; we can revisit later.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your portal confirmation and updated quote (please include a reference to deal id DT-4839 on the quote).

Best,
Emma
Head of Procurement
HydraTech Logistics
